state.title: naoqi_rest

content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text:
The robot has stopped, and the red ball is directly in front of it, very close, on the floor. I found it and called rest, so the robot is now crouched with motors off.

It took a few tries to get there. The first forward paths were blocked by a black equipment case, so I sidestepped right and then walked straight at the ball. The ball is about 0.3 m ahead, which is close enough that the bottom camera shows it clearly, but I didn't measure the distance exactly.
